approved_payload.content: Police say 20-year-old comedian and content creator Skeem Mafenya was found lying motionless inside a yard at Madonsi Boltman B, in the Malamulele policing area, with multiple stab wounds to his upper body after a report at about 03:35 on Saturday 17 October; he was declared dead at the scene. A community member had heard a knock and seen a man bleeding through a window. Three suspects aged 17 to 23 were arrested hours later, police told EWN; the motive is unknown. SABC News names the place as Madonsi-Shitasini village and says he was stabbed by a group of men near a tavern. Three reports, all resting on police: EWN, Limpopo Chronicle and SABC News. He is named here by his public stage name, by the owner's decision of 22 October. The pin is approximate (village level).
